summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K with attached Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting daily share buybacks from May 22–29, 2026. The repurchases involved 1.3 million Class A ordinary shares on May 22 at a weighted average price of USD 7.8959 per share, with similar daily transactions (exact aggregate disclosed in exhibits). Shares are held as treasury, not cancelled. The buyback represents ~0.072% of issued shares per day. Hong Kong-listed issuer buyback programs are equivalent to U.S. open-market repurchases. Watch for continued execution under the program and any volume or price limits.
